node.statement: The exact valid inference is ||h_n(Z)||^2<=b_n||Z^dagger dot Z||+C_prod*e||Z||^2: amplified adjointness and product defect give the first comparison, and boundedness of h_n gives ||h_n(Z^dagger dot Z)||<=b_n||Z^dagger dot Z||. Replacing ||Z^dagger dot Z|| by (1+kappa*e)||Z||^2 is valid at n=1 by node 1.1, but for n>1 it is precisely the unavailable uniform amplified-corner estimate identified by node 1.1. Neither amplified Ha adjointness nor amplified Ha product defect is an amplified norm axiom for the corner product. Thus no bridging argument from the allowed dependencies proves the all-n scalar quadratic; the correct repair is to restrict this conclusion to n=1 and record the missing amplified-corner theorem.
